hypothesis: Octanol engages a planarian gap-junction channel better than hexanol does, consistent with the paper's premise that hexanol 'does not efficiently block gap junction channels'.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. Receptor: AlphaFold3 (Nebius) model of the smedinx-11 octameric hemichannel (Schmidtea mediterranea innexin, UniProt A7RDN9, residues 1-370). Ligands docked with DiffDock v1.1 (Nebius), 3 seeds x 4 poses each: ethanol (negative), hexanol, heptanol, octanol, carbenoxolone (positive, a documented innexin/pannexin blocker). For each ligand: mean over seeds of the top-pose DiffDock confidence, and fraction of all poses whose centroid lies within 8 A of the channel axis inside the transmembrane span. Supports: octanol confidence exceeds hexanol's by more than 2 x the larger across-seed SD AND octanol's in-pore fraction exceeds hexanol's by >= 0.25, with carbenoxolone ranking above ethanol on confidence.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. Refutes: hexanol confidence >= octanol's and hexanol in-pore fraction >= octanol's. Inconclusive (reason 'not-operationalizable'): carbenoxolone does not outrank ethanol, the hexanol/octanol confidence difference is within 2 x the across-seed SD, or the hemichannel model's ipTM < 0.50. Anything else is mixed.
planned_datasets: uniprot-a7rdn9: UniProtKB sequence of smedinx-11 (Schmidtea mediterranea); no Girardia dorotocephala innexin sequence is in UniProtKB
nebius-alphafold3: AlphaFold 3 v3.0.4 octamer prediction on the Nebius Scientific AI Platform
nebius-diffdock: DiffDock v1.1 docking on the Nebius Scientific AI Platform

test_contract.expected_observation: Octanol docks into the hemichannel pore or transmembrane region more confidently and more often than hexanol, with the reference blocker outranking ethanol.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Hexanol docks as well as or better than octanol, both in confidence and pore occupancy.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: A planarian innexin with a documented role in regeneration, modelled as the assembled channel; docking that sees only the receptor structure and ligand SMILES; internal positive and negative ligand controls.
test_contract.inference_method: Difference in mean top-pose DiffDock confidence between octanol and hexanol, compared with across-seed variability; difference in pore-region pose fraction against a fixed 0.25 margin; gated on the carbenoxolone > ethanol control.

interpretation: Tests only the premise that octanol and hexanol differ in gap-junction engagement; the claim's phenotype (no altered head shapes after hexanol) needs new planarian experiments. Alkanol block of gap junctions is thought to act partly through the membrane rather than a defined binding site, and DiffDock confidence is a pose-quality score, not an affinity, so an inconclusive result is a likely and legitimate outcome. Schmidtea mediterranea substitutes for Girardia dorotocephala (both Tricladida; no Girardia innexin sequences are public).
